title: DHE with train-frequency rare-ID private fallback
hypothesis: On MovieLens 1M, assigning per-ID Mirror coordinates and private residuals only to items with at most a development-selected train-only frequency cutoff will improve rare-item AUC by at least 0.005 over the strongest same-cutoff non-Mirror fallback on both fresh seeds, keep overall logloss within 0.002 of shared DHE, use at most 25% of full-table payload, and retain at least 80% of no-fallback CPU throughput.
physical_object: One frozen shared DHE hash encoder/decoder and generalized-matrix-factorization head, trained on the MA-1064 training partition.
mirror_coordinate: Sixteen per-ID Givens angles per selected user or item ID; optional per-ID 32-dimensional private residual is charged separately.
logical_multiplicity: ID-specific logical embedding functions while the dense hash decoder and prediction head remain physically shared.
task: Explicit rating >=4 is positive, ratings 1-3 are negative; binary preference prediction, not CTR.

dataset.name: GroupLens MovieLens 1M
dataset.citation: F. Maxwell Harper and Joseph A. Konstan. 2015. The MovieLens Datasets: History and Context. ACM TiiS 5(4), Article 19. DOI 10.1145/2827872.
dataset.access_terms: Research use only; cite Harper and Konstan (2015); no redistribution; no commercial/revenue-bearing use without GroupLens permission.
dataset.legacy_audit_exclusion: Exclude every pair whose SHA256(user_id:item_id) modulo 10 equals 9, the MA-1063 audit partition, from all MA-1064 train/dev/audit partitions. IDs may be inspected only to apply the exclusion; MA-1063 audit labels are not loaded or reused.
dataset.new_split: For remaining pairs assign SHA256(MA-1064:user_id:item_id) modulo 10: 0-7 train, 8 development, 9 fresh audit. No pair overlap. The MA-1063 audit subset remains excluded entirely.

inherited_dhe.implementation: Reuse the MA-1063 scoped CPU DHE encoder/decoder implementation, with exact source pinned by SHA256 in FRESH_FREEZE.json.
inherited_dhe.decoder: four hidden Linear(64)+BatchNorm1d+Mish blocks followed by Linear(64,32)
inherited_dhe.head: frozen learned GMF linear head
inherited_dhe.note: This is a scaled k=128 CPU screen, not an official DHE reproduction.

methods: full independent user/item embedding tables (upper control)
selected-ID ordinary residual (32 float32 values per ID)
selected-ID private embedding replacement (32 float32 values per ID)
selected-ID Givens Mirror only (16 float32 angles per ID)
selected-ID Givens Mirror plus private residual (16 angles + 32 residual values per ID)
selection_rule: Across two development seeds, choose the cutoff for Mirror+residual with highest mean item AUC on audit-independent dev rows whose train-only item frequency is <=5, subject to overall dev logloss no worse than shared DHE by >0.002. Ties choose fewer private bytes. Freeze this one cutoff and epoch per method before fresh audit. User-frequency slices are reported when they contain >=100 rows; absent slices are explicitly unavailable. AM-01 explains why item-only selection is used.

development.training: Train one shared DHE base per seed for exactly three epochs; freeze decoder and GMF head. Train private code/residual parameters only for each cutoff and method. For each method/cutoff select epochs 1-3 by mean dev logloss across both seeds. Full-table upper control trains normally and selects epochs by the same rule.
development.metric: primary for cutoff selection: item AUC for train-only item-frequency<=5; secondary: overall binary logloss. Report user-frequency<=5 only if at least 100 dev rows are available.
development.tuning_boundary: Development only; legacy MA-1063 audit rows are excluded from every split.

fresh.audit_access: Only after protocol, source, and development-selected cutoff/epochs are frozen and committed.

success_gate: For both fresh seeds, selected Mirror+residual improves item AUC on train-frequency<=5 audit items by >=0.005 over the strongest of shared DHE, residual, private replacement, and Mirror-only at the same frozen cutoff; overall logloss <= shared DHE +0.002; complete payload <=25% of full tables; CPU batch throughput >=80% of no-fallback DHE.
failure_gate: Mirror+residual misses any fresh quality, payload, or throughput gate, or ordinary residual/private replacement matches Mirror within 0.005 rare-item AUC on both seeds.
boundaries: One MovieLens dataset; two fresh model seeds on one deterministic audit partition are not independent data worlds.
The MA-1063 audit partition is excluded entirely to prevent reusing previously scored ratings as MA-1064 training or development data.
Frequency selection uses training IDs and counts only; no audit popularity, labels, or future activity influences inference state.
No per-ID labels or audit row IDs are persisted.
A fixed three-epoch screen is not near-convergence or capacity evidence.
CPU timing is not GPU or production serving evidence.
Do not redistribute MovieLens data or use it commercially without permission.
